entry.title: RegLayer Reports Delays or Blocks for Over 47 US Data Center Projects
entry.content:
Techmeme | ft.com | source | hacker news

RegLayer reports that more than 47 large US data center projects were delayed, withdrawn, or blocked in 2026. Additionally, analysts at Bernstein estimate that only approximately 35% of the planned US data center pipeline is currently considered credible.

These disruptions highlight growing tension between the rapid expansion of AI infrastructure and physical constraints, including power grid capacity, land availability, and local regulatory opposition. The findings suggest that the logistical and economic realities of infrastructure deployment are becoming significant bottlenecks for the sector's growth.

entry.title: CoreWeave Bond Yields Surpass 15% Amid AI Infrastructure Debt Concerns
entry.content:
Techmeme | nytimes.com

CoreWeave's bond yields have climbed above 15%, signaling investor distress regarding the company's capacity to finance the massive capital requirements of AI infrastructure. The volatility has also affected broader markets, driving up insurance costs for SoftBank debt and causing some Oracle debt to trade at 80 to 90 cents on the dollar.

The surge in yields reflects growing anxieties about the long-term sustainability of the data center build-out and the heavy borrowing used to fund AI development. Analysts are questioning whether rising interest expenses will outpace operating profits, given the significant debt and lease obligations incurred by major players in the sector.
